# Frozen pre-P2 root2 fixtures

These files were emitted by the actual P1 executable tree at
`5780139b82fad932f6bc7786ea295c20602ae0a5`, archived into an isolated build directory.
They were not generated by deleting new keys from the P2 codec.

The test-only writer used that tree's existing Snow Work session fixture,
typed handoff/position setup, `OldPineWorldSaveCapture` and `GameSaveJsonCodec`.
Snow uses mstreet1 `(0,-400)`; Hockshop uses `(330,-1000)`; Old Pine uses its
existing connection handoff. The legitimate legacy relationship fixture adds
the already representable `family.fonxan` generation14 / `teacher.liu_chunfeng`
with legacy master name 柳淳风 and zero betrayer count. P1 has no affiliation block.
The writer and original headless editor both exited successfully.

P2 must decode and restore each original file, preserving its existing state.
Missing entry time becomes ABSENT for no relationship and UNKNOWN for the
nonempty relationship. No new historical class, rank or timestamp is invented.
